meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 git 事务时会先读取仓库状态,再按请求分类完成提交、改写分支历史(变基、压缩)或调查历史(blame、bisect、reflog),并附上命令与提交哈希作为证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 git 历史时触发,例如 commit、rebase、blame 等;普通的代码编辑不接管。

say.text: 把这些改动按功能拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先看 diff 和近期提交风格再分组提交

say.text: 这行代码是谁改的,用 blame 查一下
say.note: 回答会附提交哈希和行号证据

say.text: 把这三个提交压缩后变基到 main
say.note: 改写前会说明恢复路径

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads repo state first, then classifies the request to commit, rewrite branch history (rebase, squash), or investigate history (blame, bisect, reflog), citing commands and commit hashes as evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation, e.g. commit, rebase, blame; skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits by feature
say_en.note: Reads diff and recent commit style first

say_en.text: Who last changed this line? Run blame
say_en.note: Answer cites commit hash and line evidence

say_en.text: Squash these three commits and rebase onto main
